notes: STATUS DISPUTE: the Cherry and Accel rows say private; Rows was acquired by Superhuman (the renamed Grammarly) in Feb 2026 (inventure.com.ua, 2026-02-24: 'has announced the acquisition of Portuguese startup Rows.com'; standalone product phased out after three months). Entry: no press names Visionaries in any Rows round; the register places Growth Fund I on the cap table in 2020 (Rows GmbH lists of 2020-02-28 or 2020-10-26/28), i.e. at or before the Lakestar raise of March 2020, which BI calls funding (no round word) and vendor data calls Series B. Growth Fund I invests Series B onwards, consistent with a Series B label, but the round name stays undetermined. HQ: Berlin GmbH with a Porto engineering office; Portuguese press calls it Portuguese.
